messages:
maria: FYI - spike of partial responses + reconnects on prod-canary at ~11:22 UTC. Notable: many clients hit the 10s read timeout then immediately retried.
jon: Any logs or links to the postmortem draft?
maria: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/incident-2367891234 - short summary in the doc header. Key signal: partial_chunk_count up x8 and concurrent streams up x2.
praveen: hypothesis: simultaneous client immediate retries + server keepalive/idle GC interacting with KV cache eviction -> partial responses and more reconnect storms.
sasha: saw server-side keepalive churn in nodepool-3 at the same time, GC cycle overlapped with many long-lived streams.
elena: canary metrics show i/o stalls at ~9.6s before timeout, so borderline.
praveen: propose action slate (minimal, measurable):
  1) Add jittered exponential backoff to the JS + Python SDKs to avoid synchronized retries. owner: praveen, due: 2026-03-27.
  2) Bump streaming keepalive from 30s -> 60s on prod-canary and run 4h soak. owner: sasha, due: 2026-03-25.
  3) Create a "partial_chunk_rate" metric and an alert at 0.5% on 1h window. owner: elena, due: 2026-03-26.
  4) Add client-side telemetry for retry_attempts and last_retry_gap. owner: jon, due: 2026-03-28.
  5) Dashboard tile for canary to track partial_chunk_rate + KV cache evictions. owner: carlos, due: 2026-03-26.
maria: +1 to the list. Keep items small and staged so we can validate one change at a time.
praveen: SDK patch is ready locally; PR will include a small snippet: 
```
# python SDK retry example
for attempt in range(max_retries):
    wait = base * (2 ** attempt) * random.uniform(1,1.25)
    await sleep(wait)
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987
jon: good pattern. also add a counter that exposes retry_attempts as a metric so we can correlate with partial_chunk spikes. owner: jon.
ops-bot: deploy-note: canary config change window reserved 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC -> 06:00 UTC.
sasha: I'll schedule the keepalive bump during that window and run a 4-hour soak, will post raw metrics to the doc. If regressions, we'll rollback immediately.
elena: I'll add the alert + the metric and wire it to pager-too; will post query and alert JSON to the PR.
carlos: volunteering to own the canary dashboard and run manual checks post-deploy. I'll add the dashboard tile and synthetic tests for partial responses.
maria: please add each task to the remediation tracker and update status when you start/complete. tagging: @praveen @sasha @elena @jon @carlos. :thumbsup:
praveen: added checklist in the incident issue: https://redwood.internal/ops/issues/2367891234 - listed owners and due dates.
jon: one more ask - can we add a short-term client-side circuit breaker that prevents more than N immediate retries within M seconds? simple guard to reduce hammering during noisy windows. owner: jon, due: 2026-03-28.
sasha: ack, will also monitor server file descriptors and keepalive drift during soak.
maria: ops-bot created incident archive entry: incident-2367891234. We'll review outcomes in next postmortem sync on 2026-03-29 10:00 UTC. If the partial_chunk_rate < 0.2% after soak, we mark remediation success; otherwise escalate to full incident review.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: postmortem-sync @ 2026-03-29T10:00:00Z.
carlos: I'll produce a short heatmap of client retry timestamps vs server GC timestamps to validate the synchronized retry hypothesis. due 2026-03-26.
elena: added alert expression and threshold to the PR comments.
praveen: merging SDK retry change after we validate tests in CI; will coordinate with sasha before canary deploy.
maria: thanks all. keep updates concise in this thread so the on-call can follow. Closing loop for now but ping if blockers.
sasha: ack
carlos: ack
jon: ack
